units.source_text: 内装近四两酒的大白磁酒壶都空了。

en.t: The large white porcelain sake flasks, each holding nearly four liang of wine, were all empty.

units.source_text: 我施了个礼，就到典应僧那里换了一壶。

en.t: I bowed, then went to the reception monk and exchanged one for a full flask.

units.source_text: 我端着温热的酒壶回来的时候，产生了一种我过去所不懂得的感情。

en.t: As I came back carrying the warm sake flask, a feeling arose in me that I had never understood before.

units.source_text: 过去我一次也不曾泛起希望得到别人理解的冲动，到了关键时刻，却惟独希望禅海和尚的理解。

en.t: Never before had I felt even once the impulse to be understood by another person, yet at that decisive moment I wanted only Master Zenkai to understand me.

units.source_text: 再次回来劝酒的我的眼精，与方才不同，是如何闪烁着真率之光的，禅海和尚应有所体察。

en.t: Master Zenkai must have sensed how my eyes, as I returned once more to offer him wine, differed from before and shone with a sincere light.
